meta.title: CV App Privacy Policy
meta.description: Privacy policy and data handling principles for CV App.

dataCollect.title: Data We Collect
dataCollect.body: We collect your email address and resume content solely to provide CV App features. We do not sell your data to third parties.

dataUse.title: How We Use Data
dataUse.body: Your data is used for resume creation, storage and export. ATS analysis data is stored only when you explicitly save it.

dataStorage.title: Data Storage
dataStorage.body: Data is stored securely on Supabase and PostgreSQL with row-level security. Only you can access your own data.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy-related requests, contact us at privacy@cvapp.com.

meta.title: CV App Terms of Service
meta.description: Terms of service and usage conditions for CV App.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By using CV App, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

serviceUse.title: Use of Service
serviceUse.body: CV App is provided for personal resume creation. You may not use the service to create misleading or fraudulent resumes.

account.title: Account Responsibility
account.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and all activity under your account.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: CV App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for job application outcomes.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.body: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the service means you accept the updated terms.

meta.title: CV App Frequently Asked Questions
meta.description: Frequently asked questions and answers about CV App.

free.question: Is CV App free to use?
free.answer: Yes. The free plan allows up to 3 resumes and 10 PDF exports per month.

ats.question: What is ATS?
ats.answer: ATS is an Applicant Tracking System used by companies to filter resumes before human review.

share.question: Can I share my resume publicly?
share.answer: Yes. You can generate a public resume link and share it easily.

pro.question: When will Pro be available?
pro.answer: Pro is coming soon. You can start free now and upgrade when it becomes available.
